scenes.text: Here's something surprising. An LLM on its own can only write text. [1] It can't check the weather right now, or book you a cab. [2] Unless, we give it tools.

Tool use, which is also called function calling, [1] means the AI can ask your app to run a function, and then use the result in its answer. With tools, it can [2] get live data, [3] calculate things exactly, [4] and even take actions for you.

data.definition: The AI asks your app to run a function, then uses the result in its answer.

scenes.text: Let's watch it happen. [1] You ask, should I carry an umbrella in Hyderabad today? [2] Instead of guessing, the model writes a tool call, get the weather, for the city Hyderabad. [3] Your app calls the weather service, and gets back, rain, eighty percent. [4] And then the model answers, yes, carry an umbrella, there's an eighty percent chance of rain.

data.heading: Function calling, live
data.question: Should I carry an umbrella in Hyderabad today?
data.answer: Yes! There's an 80% chance of rain in Hyderabad today. Carry an umbrella.

scenes.text: Now here's the important part. [1] The AI never runs the tool by itself, it only asks. [2] Your app decides whether to run it, and then runs it. [3] Then the result goes back to the AI. And that's what keeps you in control.

data.heading: Who does what
steps: AI turns it into an answer

scenes.text: And this is already everywhere. [1] There are assistants that add events to your calendar, [2] travel apps that check flight prices live, [3] and support bots that look up your order status.

Here's a common myth. [1] People think the AI is directly logged into their apps. [2] It's not. It can only request the tools that a developer has given it. Your app does the actual work, and it should always ask you before doing anything important.

data.myth: The AI is directly logged into my apps.
data.fact: It can only request tools a developer gave it. The app does the work, and should confirm big actions.

scenes.text: Quick quiz! In function calling, who actually runs the function? [1] Pause and think. <pause 3.2> [2] It's your app! The AI only asks. Comment app if you got it!

Let's recap. [1] Tools let AI use live data, and take real actions. [2] The AI only asks for a tool, [3] your app actually runs it, [4] and the result comes back as a helpful answer.
